title: Elizondo directed AATIP, an offshoot of AAWSAP
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Elizondo directed AATIP, an offshoot of AAWSAP, about an unknown time at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he was the director of atip or the advanced aerial threat identification program which was an offshoot of assab or the advanced Aerospace Weapons Systems application program
